channel.title: Journey Home
channel.desc: Rebecca had Judaism in her background, but was raised in a fundamental form of Pentecostalism that she rebelled against strongly, going deep into a world of regrettable life decisions. Through God?s providence and some key relationships, she began to come back to faith, and was surprised to find, after her initial Christian conversion, that her true spiritual home was in the Catholic Church. She now works helping women in crisis pregnancies in Steubenville, OH. (60 minutes).
